PostInstallScript.Script:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\App Packager\CutePDF Writer' -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\App Packager\CutePDF Writer' -Name Version -Value '{version}' -PropertyType String -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null

UninstallCommand: $uninstaller = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'CutePDF Writer\unInstcpw64.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\App Packager\CutePDF Writer' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0 }; $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $uninstaller -ArgumentList @('/uninstall', '/s') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow; if ($proc.ExitCode -eq 0) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\App Packager\CutePDF Writer' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
